message: As a former folk dancer who knows moves from every land, I think what I most enjoy about this choreography are the repeated circle moves. So many Eastern European dances are in circles, although I think my favorite is a Bulgarian "shopska" that coils around, then uncoils into a straight line, all while everyone is twirling hankerchiefs in one hand and holding on to each other's belt with the other.  Hard to describe but maybe we can get a group to bust into these moves at MLA this year. ;)
